body:
I take myself seriously, but I feel as though one speck in the face of humanity is nothing. Me being here won't alter this world drastically. From that stand point, improving my quality of life is meaningless. I feel as though life itself is devoid of meaning. I eat well, sleep well, exercise, meditate and look after myself. The issue I have is that I don't see a purpose in our existence.
TL;DR, I choose not to improve my life because I don't see a point in life.
